includedPullRequests.title: Scale compact Dynamic Island text instead of truncating it in a narrow island
includedPullRequests.body: closes #1657 only the compact Dynamic Island views are changed (`LiveActivityCompactLeadingView`, `LiveActivityCompactTrailingView` in LiveActivityView.swift, and one `contentMargins` line in LiveActivity.swift). expanded, minimal, lock screen and watch views are not changed. as @kamilosxdman showed, with a second Live Activity the compact island shows `…→ …`. as @MikePlante1 showed, in landscape on iOS 27 the arrow and the delta are cut off. cause: iOS 27 makes the compact views narrower when the island shows more than one Live Activity, and in landscape. the compact views have no `lineLimit` or `minimumScaleFactor`, so the glucose and the delta truncate to `…`. in landscape, `.contentMargins(.trailing, 0, for: .compactLeading)` makes the leading view wider than the visible pill, so the text does not scale and the pill edge cuts the arrow. change: - `.lineLimit(1)` and `.minimumScaleFactor(0.5)` on both compact views, so the text scales down instead of truncating - remove `.contentMargins(.trailing, 0, for: .compactLeading)`, so the leading view stays inside the pill - remove `.padding(.leading, 4)` from the compact leading view, so the glucose keeps more room (with 2 activities it scales to about 0.76 instead of 0.6) with one activity the glucose keeps its full size and position; the pill is about 4 pt narrower on the left, on iOS 26 too. I chose scaling because CI builds with Xcode 26.5. iOS 27 has a better way: `isDynamicIslandLimitedInWidth` tells the view that the island is narrow, so it could show only the glucose, larger (as the HIG suggests). the Xcode 26.5 SDK does not have it; behind `#if compiler(>=6.4)` it compiles, but CI builds would not get it. tested in the simulator (iPhone 18 Pro Max iOS 27.0, iPhone 17 Pro iOS 26.5), built with Xcode 27.1, second activity = Safari audio: - before: 2 activities `…→ …`; landscape `8,9-` and `+…` - after: 2 activities `8,9→ +0,0`, a bit smaller; landscape `8,9→` and `+0,0`; mg/dL `161→ +1`; one activity unchanged on both iOS versions | | before | after | | --- | --- | --- | | 2 activities, iOS 27 | | | | landscape, iOS 27 | | | | one activity, iOS 27 | | | | one activity, iOS 26.5 | | |

includedPullRequests.title: Make schedule unit tests DST-safe
includedPullRequests.body:
Two test helpers built times as "midnight + N hours" or measured elapsed minutes since midnight. On a DST day (25 Oct in Europe has 25 hours) those land an hour off from the wall clock, so CI fails on `dev` and every PR today:

- `ScheduledBasalInferenceTests`: `time(_:_:)` now uses `Calendar.date(bySettingHour:minute:second:of:)`. The old helper also crashed the test host (index out of range) once a segment went missing.
- `BolusCalculatorTests`: the test-local `getCurrentSettingValue` now reads wall-clock hour and minute.

The app code under test already uses wall-clock boundaries, so this is test-only. Verified on 25 Oct (CET, 25-hour day): both suites, 22 tests, pass; before the change 3 tests failed.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
